# AlexClaw 0.4.0

## Upgrading from 0.3.x

- **Cluster:** a `receive_from_workflow` step with an empty or absent
  `allowed_nodes` now allows no node to trigger its workflow (in 0.3.x it
  allowed any connected node). Before upgrading, list in each gate the nodes
  that send to it, and register each of those nodes in the admin UI (Cluster
  page): a node is no longer registered by connecting.
- **Cluster:** a workflow whose first step is `receive_from_workflow` can no
  longer be run locally (admin UI, schedule): it runs only when a node named
  in its `allowed_nodes` triggers it.
